facts: Enron states it believes in the inherent wisdom of open markets, consumer choice, and competition.
The company values diversity in people and thought to maintain an outstanding workforce.
Enron aims to meet customer energy needs with solutions that offer a competitive advantage.
The text mentions a commitment to operating safely and with concern for the environment.
Enron describes itself as a laboratory of innovation that employs top talent.
The copyright notice spans the years 1997 to 2000 for Enron Corp.
